description: This PHP source file defines the class TimesheetItemDecorator within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to manipulate and decorate TimesheetItem entities, including setting related entities like Project, ProjectActivity, Timesheet, and Employee by their identifiers, as well as retrieving formatted start date.

classes.name: TimesheetItemDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for TimesheetItem, providing methods to set related entities based on identifiers and formatting date fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a TimesheetItem instance.

methods.name: getTimesheetItem
methods.description: Returns the TimesheetItem instance associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Sets the Project entity of the TimesheetItem based on a given project ID.

methods.name: setProjectActivityById
methods.description: Sets the ProjectActivity entity of the TimesheetItem based on a given activity ID.

methods.name: setTimesheetById
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with the TimesheetItem using its ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the TimesheetItem based on employee number.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the TimesheetItem formatted as a string.
